title: Finite-Sample Bias Correction for Plug-in Estimators of Extropy, Rényi Extropy, and Tsallis Extropy
summary: This paper studies the finite-sample bias of plug-in estimators for Shannon, Rényi, and Tsallis extropies for finitely supported discrete random variables. We derive explicit first-order bias formulas for all three estimators by analyzing the bias of the intermediate functional S_α= \sum_{i=1}^r (1-p_i)^α. Bias-corrected estimators are then proposed. We show that the uncorrected and corrected estimators are asymptotically equivalent, differing only by terms of order O(1/n).
